离开青龙星系（离开青龙星系（第22页）李三缺掐诀，打出一道道符文，艰难的用地灵书秘法，将恐怖的地脉之气能量风暴撕裂。
三人前行速度非常的慢，几乎一个时辰，才能迈出百丈左右距离。
又过去两日，林浩三人才来到有着传送阵的地方。
这处传送阵非常的古老，从表面上看十分残破。
林浩目光落在古传送阵上，脸上露出怀疑之色，道：“三缺前辈，这个传送阵真能使用吗？”
“嘿，别看这传送阵破烂不堪，实际乃是修为境界深不可测的强者布置，只是能量供给坏了而已，传送符文完全没有问题。”
李三缺笑着道：“我以地脉之术化作能量，去催动此传送阵，足以把我们传送出青龙星系。”
说完，李三缺浑身元力涌动，凝聚出一枚枚符文，打入传送阵之中。
恐怖的地脉之气受到牵引，快速在传送阵聚集，残破不堪的传送阵，竟然涌现出浓浓的传送之力。
林浩三人腾空而起，身形消失在传送旋涡之中。
在封锁青龙星系的巨型阵法外，有数名合体境巅峰的大罗宗强者盘膝而坐，依托着大罗宗大乘境强者布置的顶级阵法，就是玄火地龙族、逆灵宗的大乘境强者，短时间内也无法从这里离开。
这个阵法重点针对大乘境强者，而对于合体境或者以下强者，虽然也会阻拦，但基本上都是以监视为主。
毕竟在封锁阵法区域，大罗宗驻守的修士，除了数名合体境巅峰强者，还有不少合体境后期、中期强者。
就算有合体境或者以下境界的修士闯出了阵法，九成九以上几率会被阵法检测出来，逃不了多远，便会被大罗宗的合体境修士追上。
只有李三缺这种掌控了地灵书绝学的人，才有机会瞒过封锁阵法的检测，悄悄溜之大吉。
“得到在青龙星的执事传讯，我们的人在青龙星突然被灭杀，有其他人出现在青龙星。”
其中一名合体境巅峰强者皱了皱眉头，快速掐诀朝着封锁大阵一指。

蓦然间封锁大阵光华大作，散发出一道神光，直奔青龙星而去。
封锁大阵不仅可以抵挡一段时间玄火地龙族、逆灵宗的大乘境强者，监视想从青龙星系离开的修士，还可以主动出击，去查探整个青龙星的情况。
此举虽然消耗的能量比较大，却能在极短时间内，将青龙星的修士情况查探出来。
合体境巅峰强者目中忽然闪过一抹精芒道：“竟然是通过传送阵离开！”
倘若封锁大阵没有被镇守此地的合体境巅峰强者复苏，以李三缺的地灵书秘法手段，可以做到悄悄从封锁大阵中溜走。
可林浩三人传送之时，还是晚了一些时间，撞上了封锁大阵复苏，被封锁大阵查探到虚空中残留的一缕传送气息。

Chapter 2177 Leaving the Qinglong Galaxy (page 1)
Leaving the Qinglong Galaxy (Leaving the Qinglong Galaxy (page 22)) Li Sanque made a secret spell, punched out runes one after another, and used the Earth Spirit Book secret method with great difficulty to tear apart the terrifying earth energy energy storm.
The three of them moved forward very slowly. It took almost an hour to cover a distance of about a hundred feet.
Two more days passed before Lin Hao and the other three arrived at the place with the teleportation array.
This teleportation array is very old and looks very dilapidated on the surface.
Lin Hao's eyes fell on the ancient teleportation array, with a look of doubt on his face, and he said: "Senior Sanque, can this teleportation array really be used?"
"Hey, despite the fact that this teleportation array is in tatters, it is actually arranged by a strong person with an unfathomable cultivation level. It's just that the energy supply is broken. There is no problem with the teleportation runes."
Li Sanque said with a smile: "I use the art of earth veins to turn it into energy to activate this teleportation array, which is enough to teleport us out of the Qinglong Galaxy."
After saying that, Li Sanque's energy surged all over his body, and he condensed runes one by one and punched them into the teleportation array.
The terrifying energy of the earth's veins was pulled and quickly gathered in the teleportation array. The dilapidated teleportation array unexpectedly emerged with strong teleportation power.
Lin Hao and three others rose into the air and disappeared into the teleportation vortex.
Outside the giant formation that sealed off the Qinglong Galaxy, there were several powerful Daluo Sect masters at the peak of the Fusion Realm sitting cross-legged. Relying on the top-level formations arranged by the Daluo Sect's Mahayana Realm strongmen, even the powerful Mahayana Realm masters from the Xuanhuo Earth Dragon Clan and Niling Sect were unable to leave here in a short time.
This formation focuses on those who are strong in the Mahayana realm. Although it will also block those who are strong in the Fusion realm or below, it is basically focused on surveillance.
After all, in the sealing formation area, the monks stationed by Daluo Sect, in addition to several peak Fusion Realm experts, also have many late and mid-stage Fusion Realm experts.
Even if a monk at or below the Fusion Realm breaks out of the formation, there is a 99% or higher chance that it will be detected by the formation, and he will not be able to escape far before being overtaken by the Fusion Realm monks from Daluo Sect.
Only people like Li Sanque, who have mastered the secret knowledge of the Earth Spirit Book, have the opportunity to escape the detection of the sealing formation and sneak away quietly.
"I received a summons from the deacon in Qinglong Star. Our people were suddenly killed in Qinglong Star. Others appeared in Qinglong Star."
One of the peak Fusion Realm experts frowned and quickly gestured towards the sealing formation.
Suddenly, the sealing formation burst into glory, emitting a divine light and heading straight for the Qinglong Star.
The blockade formation can not only withstand the powerful Mahayana warriors of the Xuanhuo Dragon Clan and Niling Sect for a period of time, and monitor the monks who want to leave the Qinglong Galaxy, but can also take the initiative to investigate the situation of the entire Qinglong Star.
Although this move consumes a lot of energy, it can detect the situation of the monks on Qinglong Star in a very short time.
A flash of light suddenly flashed in the eyes of the peak Fusion Realm expert: "He actually left through the teleportation array!"
If the sealing formation is not revived by the peak Fusion Realm expert guarding this place, Li Sanque can sneak out of the sealing formation quietly with Li Sanque's Earth Spirit Calligraphy secret method.
However, when Lin Hao and the others teleported, they were still a little late and bumped into the blockade formation's revival. The blockade formation detected a trace of teleportation breath remaining in the void.
